title: I love this product
text: I love this product. This does require a little bit of muscle to use, but it's worth it. I've bought 2 so far. I absolutely love potatoes made with this.  Stick them in the air fryer for a French fry or chip like taste. Low calorie. Brush with a bit of olive oil if needed. Awesome!!!!! I also used it on a zucchini in the air fryer. A bit of parmesan and was delish. Healthy meals or snacks.
